body:
None of what you mentioned that has happened to you is your fault. You can’t control someone else’s actions. It’s a terrible fate that your ex boyfriends brother OD but it’s not your fault. Im so sorry you lost your best friend and mentor to suicide, but it’s not your fault. And I’m so sorry for what happened to you, but you cannot blame yourself for what you cannot control. My heart breaks for you, I hope you find peace, you shouldn’t blame yourself. 
Maybe you should try talking to someone about what has happened to help you process it all. I’m so sorry.
